_comment: Recipe template. Copy to <project root>/.dbops/recipes.json (project-level, takes priority) or ~/.dbops/recipes.json (global). prompt is a full natural-language workflow the model breaks down and executes; template variables <param> are extracted from the user's instruction; danger: true forces the dangerous-operation confirmation.

recipes.name: Look up user
recipes.prompt: Look up the user with email <email> in the user table: id, email, email verification status, shown in reverse creation order

recipes.name: Clean up test data
recipes.prompt: Delete test users in the user table whose email ends with @test.local; count them first, then delete
